details.name: Idle Demon Lord II
details.short_description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

details.name: 挂机魔王 II
details.short_description: 《挂机魔王 II》是一款暗黑刷宝 × 放置增量 ARPG。自动战斗、装备驱动成长。独创一机六开独立挂机，五大深度职业、六档装备稀有度、暗黑4式回火精炼工作台与无尽大秘境。告别体力与卡进度，享受最纯粹的暗金爆率与终局配装乐趣。
